title: Roast potatoes, halloumi and cherry tomatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, halloumi, honey and herbs are all whole foods or simple cheeses with nothing factory-built.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including a 225g block of halloumi, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large roasting tray, a knife and a board, and the technique is simple tossing and roasting.

works.reason: 600g potatoes, 400g tomatoes and 225g halloumi make a sensible breakfast for four, and 40 minutes at 220°C with staged additions will cook everything through without burning.

honest_times.reason: Cubing potatoes, halving mushrooms, slicing halloumi and snipping chives fit in 15 minutes, and the 20+10+10 roasting matches the 40 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps under its true name, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A generous 400g of roasted, burst cherry tomatoes is right for late September and central to the plate rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, vegetables and halloumi make a filling, real-food cooked breakfast a family would happily repeat.
